project_meta.title: The Man Hiding Outside Her House

global_style.art_style: Clean 2D cartoon illustration, indie webcomic art style, thin black line art, soft neutral-toned flat watercolor wash fills, minimalist background, storybook animation frame. Simple, modern digital drawing, flat design. Cinematic vertical compositions, expressive character faces, subtle shadows, varied camera angles, suspenseful atmosphere without graphic violence.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, gore, graphic violence, sexual assault depiction, explicit content, exaggerated horror, overly bright colors, messy backgrounds, text, subtitles, watermarks, inconsistent character designs.

woman.label: Woman walking home
woman.visual_dna: A young adult woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a muted blue jacket, dark jeans, and comfortable sneakers. Alert expression, expressive eyes, consistent facial features and clothing throughout.

stalker.label: Man following her
stalker.visual_dna: An adult man with short dark hair, wearing a dark hooded jacket, dark trousers, and ordinary sneakers. His face is partially shadowed, with a suspicious and unsettling expression. Keep his appearance consistent.

home.label: Woman's house
home.visual_dna: A modest suburban house with a front door, small porch, windows, and a narrow pathway leading to the street. A few plants and bushes near the entrance. Evening lighting.

bushes.label: Bushes outside the house
bushes.visual_dna: Dense green bushes beside the woman's house, close to the front pathway. Thick enough to conceal a person standing behind them.

police_officers.label: Police officers
police_officers.visual_dna: Two adult police officers wearing dark standard police uniforms, utility belts, and serious expressions. Professional and alert body language.

evidence.label: Items found on the man
evidence.visual_dna: A small collection of evidence items represented non-graphically: a set of handcuffs, a knife with its blade safely covered, and a packet of condoms. Arranged on an evidence table.

phone.label: Woman's phone
phone.visual_dna: A modern smartphone with a dark screen, used by the woman to call emergency services. No visible brand or readable text.

beats.narration_text: वह एक शाम अपने घर लौट रही थी। रास्ता लगभग खाली था और उसे बस जल्दी से घर पहुँचकर आराम करना था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} walking alone along a quiet residential street in the evening. Her house is visible in the distance, with soft street lighting and an otherwise empty road.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the quiet evening atmosphere and her ordinary walk home.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन कुछ देर बाद उसे महसूस हुआ कि कोई आदमी उसके पीछे चल रहा है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} glancing over her shoulder. In the distant background, {assets.stalker} is walking in the same direction, maintaining some distance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the man following her without revealing his intentions.

beats.narration_text: उसने अपनी चाल तेज़ कर दी, लेकिन वह आदमी भी उसके पीछे आता रहा। अब उसे साफ़ लगने लगा था कि कुछ गड़बड़ है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} walking faster with a worried expression while {assets.stalker} remains behind her in the same direction. Keep both characters visible at different distances.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Increase tension through her faster steps and anxious expression.

beats.narration_text: जब वह अपने घर के पास पहुँची, तो उस आदमी ने खुद को पास की झाड़ियों में छिपा लिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.stalker} crouching behind {assets.bushes} beside {assets.home}. The woman is approaching the front entrance, unaware of exactly where he is hiding.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the man's hiding place and create a suspenseful visual contrast.

beats.narration_text: वह किसी तरह जल्दी से घर के अंदर पहुँची और दरवाज़ा बंद कर लिया। लेकिन उसके मन में डर अभी भी बना हुआ था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} inside {assets.home}, closing the front door and leaning against it with a frightened expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Move the action indoors and show her immediate relief mixed with fear.

beats.narration_text: उसने देर नहीं की। अपना फोन उठाया और तुरंत पुलिस को कॉल कर दिया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} holding {assets.phone} near her ear, speaking urgently while standing near the closed front door.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on her decision to seek help immediately.

beats.narration_text: उसने पुलिस को बताया कि एक आदमी उसका पीछा कर रहा था और अब उसके घर के बाहर कहीं छिपा हुआ है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} explaining the situation over {assets.phone}. Her expression is tense, and her eyes occasionally glance toward the front window.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize her fear and urgency while she explains what happened.

beats.narration_text: कुछ ही देर में पुलिस वहाँ पहुँच गई। अधिकारियों ने बिना शोर किए घर के आसपास की जगह को ध्यान से देखना शुरू किया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.police_officers} carefully approaching {assets.home} and inspecting the area around {assets.bushes}. The scene should feel quiet and tense.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the police response and shift the focus outside the house.

beats.narration_text: पुलिस ने झाड़ियों के पास जाँच की, और वहाँ छिपा हुआ वही आदमी पकड़ लिया गया।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.police_officers} discovering {assets.stalker} behind {assets.bushes}. One officer approaches him while the other remains alert. No physical violence.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the man's capture without showing unnecessary force.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन असली डरावनी बात तो तब सामने आई, जब पुलिस को उसके पास कुछ ऐसी चीज़ें मिलीं जिनका वहाँ होना बिल्कुल सामान्य नहीं था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.evidence} arranged on a clean evidence table. Use a serious investigative atmosphere without graphic or explicit details.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Build suspense around the items discovered by the police.

beats.narration_text: उसके पास हथकड़ियाँ, एक चाकू और कंडोम मिले। अब यह मामला सिर्फ पीछा किए जाने तक सीमित नहीं लग रहा था।
beats.prompt_action: Show a closer view of {assets.evidence}, with the handcuffs, covered knife, and packet clearly distinguishable but presented non-graphically.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the discovered items one by one through the composition.

beats.narration_text: बाद में बताया गया कि उस आदमी का डीएनए इलाके में हुई छह रेप की घटनाओं से मैच हुआ था।
beats.prompt_action: Show a police investigation setting with {assets.police_officers} reviewing case files and a DNA evidence report represented with abstract, unreadable markings. No real victims or assault scenes.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Connect the suspect to the reported investigation through symbolic forensic visuals.

beats.narration_text: बाद में उस महिला ने बताया कि वह अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए पहले से स्प्रिंट ट्रेनिंग करती थी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} running during an athletic sprint training session on an outdoor track. Her posture is strong and focused, with natural daylight.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Transition into a visual flashback showing her running practice.

beats.narration_text: उसी ट्रेनिंग की वजह से वह उस आदमी से तेज़ भाग पाई और अपने घर तक पहुँच सकी।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} sprinting along the residential street toward {assets.home}. Use dynamic motion lines and a clear sense of speed, with no physical contact or attack.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Visually connect her running ability with her escape.

beats.narration_text: उसका मानना था कि अगर वह इतनी तेज़ नहीं भाग पाती, तो शायद उस रात उसके साथ कुछ बहुत बुरा हो सकता था।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.woman} sitting safely inside {assets.home}, looking thoughtful and shaken as she remembers the incident. Keep the atmosphere quiet and respectful.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End on her emotional reaction and the seriousness of what could have happened.

beats.narration_text: सोचिए, वह आदमी उसके घर के बाहर छिपा बैठा था और उसके पास ऐसी चीज़ें भी थीं। अगर उसने उस दिन अपनी ट्रेनिंग और अपनी समझ पर भरोसा नहीं किया होता, तो क्या होता?
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.home} from across the quiet street at night. {assets.bushes} are visible beside the house, while a warm light glows through the window. Create a reflective, suspenseful ending.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Close the story with a quiet visual reminder of the danger she escaped.
